notes.title: UPDATE IS UP (K Ending Patch and Trainer Fix)
notes.content:
UPDATES: 

--K's Ending (Fixed) **Diana dies in battle 
--After losing your trainer, you go through lone training and instantly get back into the route you were on without snapping back a day. 
--Major grammar/writing fixes in James's Route. 

More updates will come soon, as I have been working on the Seduce Me Episode series as well as KS rewards. 

https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series 

-------- 

"Michaela!! How does updating the game work!?" 

Well, the game should reinstall and update automatically for you. If not, you can go to your Library tab and check the game properties to find how to update your game. It's a simply reinstall. 

JUST BE AWARE: You MAY have to start over on the route you were on because the bugs in the game were adjusted and will not carry over. All CGs and unlocked specials you obtained will remain, but to fix the errors and inconsistencies in the game, you may have to start from the beginning again to reset the game script and load in the new fixes.

notes.title: Update/Patch Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Michaela here!

I took a little vacation from work and went back to the grind last night! I SHOULD have an update/patch available tonight if not tomorrow BUT here is what I fixed:

-A handful of Audio problems
-K's Ending Prompts (Meaning you can poison Diana now and K actually talks about it... though I don't know why you'd poison her...)
-Some grammar/typos
-BLOOPERS!!!!!!

There are a LOT of bloopers, so prepare yourselves!
